node.title: One-swap anchor packets synchronize every rational exception pencil
node.closure: a star of admissible one-swap packets shares at least nineteen fixed locators, which uniquely determines their two-dimensional polynomial pencil
node.statement: Fix any 5524 first-owned slopes of the dense heavy-ruling anchor pair, the at most four secondary pair types, three slopes from each secondary type, and globally core-saturated exact supports. Put s=32-3t, so 20<=s<=29. Choose one base s-subset of the fixed anchor slopes and, for every remaining fixed anchor slope, replace one base slope. Apply the existing packet trichotomy to this base packet and all one-swap packets. Either at least one packet has chi>=2299571, or every packet is rational and all 5524 fixed anchor exception locators lie in one coprime degree-1-through-11 pencil. Indeed every one-swap rational pencil shares s-1>=19 distinct locators with the base pencil, while two distinct monic locators already determine the two-dimensional polynomial subspace. No payment of either output is claimed.
